description:
FILED s446i (Opus agent I), from the #508 probes.  PRE-EXISTING: the same hole
is in #464's `local(LIST) = RHS if COND` shape, shipped s441b and reviewed.

REPRODUCER:

    our $p; $p = 1;
    { local $p if 0; $p = 9; print $p; }
    print ",", $p, "\n";
        perl  9,9      (the statement never ran, so nothing is localized)
        PCL   9,1      (the block's write is undone at block exit)

CAUSE: PCL's `local` is an ALWAYS-OPEN let / p-local-cell, so "do not localize"
is spelled "localize to a COPY OF THE CURRENT VALUE".  That is observationally
identical only while nothing WRITES the slot inside the scope -- a save and
restore of an unchanged slot is invisible, a save and restore around a write is
not.  Every other row of the family agrees with perl (12 of 13 probes in s446i,
and the #464 rows before that).

SHAPE OF A FIX: make the SAVE/RESTORE itself conditional, not the value.
  * the ORDINARY-global (p-local-cell) half is direct -- a `p-local-cell-if`
    that saves + installs only when the condition holds and restores only if it
    saved;
  * the EXCEPTION half (defvar + dynamic let: the magic vars, $a/$b, the
    temporaries) needs `progv` with a runtime-computed name list --
    `(progv (if c '($x) '()) (if c (list new) '()) BODY)` is a conditional
    dynamic bind and is still an OPEN form, which the emission style requires.
Both are new emission shapes on the `local` path, which is hot, so measure:
the plain (unconditional) spellings must keep today's forms exactly.

BAR: the reproducer + the same with an array/hash/element target + the
`local(LIST) = RHS if 0` twin + a write from a CALLED SUB (the whole point of
`local`) + the unconditional spellings byte-identical in corpus-diff; the
existing stmt-modifier-01.t rows are the regression net.


RULED s449 (Fable, 2026-08-29): fix shape APPROVED as sketched here -- the SAVE/RESTORE becomes conditional, never the value.  (i) ordinary-global half: a p-local-cell-if sibling macro -- condition evaluated ONCE before any save; saves+installs only when true; restores only if it saved.  (ii) exception half (defvar dynamic-let: magic vars, $a/$b, temporaries): progv with runtime-computed name/value lists -- still an open form.  The statement-modifier condition guards the WHOLE statement: in `local X = RHS if COND`, RHS must NOT evaluate when COND is false (probe perl).  HARD CONSTRAINT = the bar-s first leg: unconditional spellings keep today-s emitted forms BYTE-IDENTICAL in corpus-diff (the local path is hot).  Rest of the bar as listed (incl. the called-sub write case, the whole point of local).  Scheduled: Opus round 8.
subject: SILENT WRONG: a WRITE inside the scope of a FALSE-conditioned `local` does not survive the block -- `our $p=1; { local $p if 0; $p = 9; } print $p` perl 9, PCL 1
